title: COTIA: Concolic Testing with Intelligent Agent
problem: Concolic testing for hardware verification suffers from suboptimal path exploration due to local optima in heuristics, leading to incomplete coverage of corner cases.
method: The system uses a large language model to guide an agent exploring hardware through beam search, which maintains multiple candidate paths simultaneously instead of following a single path. The LLM learns from each test execution which paths are more likely to find corner cases and adjusts the exploration strategy in real-time. This dynamic guidance helps the agent escape the dead ends where traditional heuristics typically get stuck.
key_novelty: COTIA is the first to use large language models with beam search to dynamically guide path exploration in hardware concolic testing.
contributions: LLM-based intelligent agent framework for path exploration
Significantly improved branch coverage especially for hard-to-detect branches
Optimized computational resource usage during verification
